verdict.rationale: Kit's API overview says developers can "manage your email list through tags and custom fields" [kit-docs-46], and broadcasts can target subscribers by segment or tag IDs [kit-docs-2], which implies tag and segment objects are addressable by API. The official Kit MCP exposes tags and segments with read/write access to account data [kit-docs-29, kit-docs-58], and list endpoints are paginated with cursors up to 1000 per page [kit-docs-34, kit-docs-53]. However, no specific endpoint is cited for creating or updating segments, or for listing which subscribers belong to a given tag or segment. Missing for 10: documented tag/segment create and update endpoints, a documented endpoint to list a tag's or segment's member subscribers, evidence that segments (not just tags) can be created via the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
